firstPlayerRule: The sneakiest player starts. The rules also allow choosing randomly.
clarifications: Play continues clockwise. Starting players put 3, 2, 1 and 0 Clank cubes into the Clank Area in turn order, using only the positions needed for your player count.
The rulebook does not define a measure for deciding who is sneakiest.
